text:
Asha: quick idea for rollout strategy for geo-staggered model switch. propose 3-phase: small canary in us-west (1% users), regional ramp (10%, 25%), global (100%) with circuit breaker by 95th latency and quality regression. details below.
Carlos: sounds good. question: how do we handle model variant fallback? canary should fall back to previous model on >3% errors or latency spike > 2x baseline.
Maya: add infrastructure kill-switch: link to runbook and runbook steps. also prefer green/blue pods per region so rollback is instant.
Liam: for A/B quality, suggest hold 10k prompts baseline per cohort and run automatic evals on generation quality + token cost delta. if quality drops >5% on semantic eval, auto halt.
Asha: agree. flag naming: rollouts/model-switch/<region>/<model-version>. example: rollouts/model-switch/us-west/m-v2
Carlos: small note: ensure KV cache warmup for v2. add prefix-cache-copy as part of migration script.
Asha: propose telemetry gates:
- p50/p95 latency
- error_rate
- semantic-quality (embedding-similarity)
- cost_per_1k_tokens
Trigger thresholds: p95>1.8x baseline OR error_rate>0.03 => pause and rollback.
Maya: operational thresholds sound ok. also require circuit-breaker to trigger an immediate traffic split to stable variant: 95% stable / 5% canary for 10 min before full rollback.
Carlos: for A/B tests: create separate feature flag: experiments/model-v2-ab/<cohort-id>. This lets us test content quality without affecting all users.
Nina: legal: make sure customer-facing enterprise tenants get an opt-out flag for private deployments and a contract clause if model changes affect regulated outputs.
Asha: good catch. add customer opt-out list in the rollout config and ensure KMS key rotation doesn't interrupt private deployments.
Carlos: sample flag JSON for ops:
```
{
  "flag": "rollouts/model-switch/us-west/m-v2",
  "phases": [
    {"pct": 1, "duration_mins": 60},
    {"pct": 10, "duration_mins": 180},
    {"pct": 100, "duration_mins": 0}
  ],
  "fallback": "m-v1",
  "telemetry_gates": ["p95_latency","error_rate","semantic_quality"]
}
```
Liam: can we wire the semantic_quality metric to embedding-based regressions? i'll add a job in the eval pipeline to run on rolling prompt set.
Maya: what about cross-region warmup? we should pre-warm caches by shadowing traffic (0% impact) for 2 hours before stage 2.
Carlos: agreed. add a 'shadow_warmup_mins' in the flag schema.
Asha: action items:
- Carlos: add prefix-cache-copy + shadow warmup to rollout PR
- Liam: implement semantic_quality metric + dashboard
- Maya: author runbook with precise rollback steps and circuit-breaker settings
- Nina: draft contract addendum for enterprise opt-out
I'll open a launch checklist PR and tag everyone. :rocket:
deploy-bot: deployment will be gated by feature flags; remember to run `./scripts/rollout-checklist --region us-west --dry-run`
Carlos: I'll start the PR today, will ping once ready.
Maya: I'll draft the runbook and post for review.
Liam: adding the eval job to the nightly pipeline now.
Nina: will send the legal note to PMs by EOD.
Asha: thanks all — let's reconvene Wed 10am to review PRs and tests. :+1:
